summary: Connect social, SEO, and campaign data to useful decisions. Explore practical analytics training and enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Social media and digital marketing analytics connects campaign goals with social, search, and website data. Designed for digital marketing managers, social media analysts, and campaign specialists, it helps turn fragmented channel results into consistent, decision-ready reporting. You will map objectives to KPIs, plan and validate UTM tagging and conversion data, interpret SEO and social performance, compare attribution models, and outline API data requirements; API integration and advanced attribution are covered conceptually, not as implementation training.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who already work with social, web, search, or campaign data and need to make their reporting more consistent and useful.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with social media or digital marketing campaigns and basic performance metrics is expected. No coding or API configuration is required; API data collection and integration are introduced at a planning and operational-awareness level.
